limitations: No source snippet or virtual file was provided, so the changes are specified precisely as a transformation checklist rather than as line-level edits.
response: Make the smallest behavior-preserving refactor: move the inline async JSX callback to a named handler such as handleDelete. In that handler, return immediately when confirmation is declined; take a snapshot of the IDs to delete from the current selectedIds value; await the delete mutation with that snapshot; navigate only after the mutation succeeds; and define the button's visual modifier through the project's existing class composition mechanism instead of embedding new conditional styling logic in JSX. Keep selectedIds-derived values derived during render (or memoized only if computation cost justifies it), rather than copying them into independent state or synchronizing them with an effect. The button should explicitly use type="button" when it is inside or may be moved into a form, retain an accessible name, and be disabled while deletion is pending or when there is nothing valid to delete if that matches existing behavior. Preserve the current confirmation text, mutation payload, navigation destination, and error behavior; do not introduce unrelated cleanup. Check these rules: event handlers are named and readable; the confirmation branch uses an early return; promises are deliberately awaited and failures do not trigger success navigation; closures use the intended current ID snapshot; derived data has a single source of truth; no redundant state/effect is added; hooks and dependencies remain valid; class names follow the existing naming and composition convention and the modifier is actually styled; JSX has no unnecessary nested branching; destructive-action semantics and accessibility remain intact; and the diff contains no behavioral drift. Lint alone is insufficient evidence for an async destructive flow even under the five-minute constraint: after lint, run the available type check and the narrowest relevant test, then manually review the final diff and exercise both confirmation outcomes plus mutation failure/success and post-success navigation. If time prevents any check, report that check as unverified rather than claiming completion.
